subject: Notification issue - study 3519 - participant 90900
body:
Dear Amir,

Could you please check if there are any ‘background’ issues for participant 90900 in study 3519?

Participant is not always receiving notifications, if notification is received participant needs to log in again, and hereby then also misses a lot of notifications.

We have been in contact with this participant. Participant has all settings correct/notifications on, leaves app running in the background, has deleted and re-installed the app, the app is up to date, phone has been reset, … so we are out of options to suggest to the participant.

Could you please check if there are any issues for this participant?

Thank you for taking up this issue with urgency!

Best regards,

Eva Vanbrabant
